description: This file defines MIDI-related constants and static methods for handling MIDI message types, lengths, and status checks, following the MIDI Standard 1.0.

classes.name: MidiConstants
classes.description: Contains MIDI status byte constants, message length arrays, and utility methods for MIDI message processing.

methods.name: getBytesPerMessage
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes in a MIDI message based on the status byte.

methods.name: isAllActiveSensing
methods.description: Checks if a byte array contains only Active Sensing messages.
